result:
Summary: The sources report that in the full wiki setting of the HotpotQA dataset, the retrieval performance for Hits@10 is 56.06 on the test set. The Hits@10 metric measures the proportion of questions for which the correct answer is among the top 10 retrieved paragraphs. The sources do not provide specific figures for Hits@10 for values other than 0.56.
